paragraphs: Rav Shimi bar Adda. Mentioned in Nazir 50b, where he raised a difficulty to Rav Papa.[^1]

notes.text: Nazir 50b in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic explicitly has Rav Shimi bar Adda addressing Rav Papa with a difficulty. This supports expanding ר״פ as Rav Papa for this occurrence; both titles are explicit in that passage. The source locator נ: is rendered 50b.
